## Above ^^^ ADT preliminary

## select only clusters related to myeloid differentiation, exclude conteminating peripheral clusters

```{r}
Idents(dc) <- "seurat_clusters"
dcSub <- subset(dc, idents = c(0,1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11))

dcSub <- NormalizeData(dcSub)
dcSub <- FindVariableFeatures(dcSub, selection.method = "mean.var.plot")
dcSub <- ScaleData(dcSub, features = VariableFeatures(dcSub))
dcSub <- RunPCA(dcSub, features = VariableFeatures(dcSub))

VizDimLoadings(dcSub, dims = 1:4, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(dcSub, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(dcSub, ndims = 40)
dcSub <- JackStraw(dcSub, num.replicate = 100, dims = 50)
dcSub <- ScoreJackStraw(dcSub, dims = 1:40)

# 'Significant' PCs will show a strong enrichment of features with low p-values (solid curve above the dashed line). 
JackStrawPlot(dcSub, dims = 1:40)
```

```{r}
dcSub <- FindNeighbors(dcSub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:29)
dcSub <- RunTSNE(dcSub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
dcSub <- RunUMAP(dcSub, dims = 1:20)

FeaturePlot(dcSub, features = "nFeature_RNA", split.by = "HTO_maxID", ncol = 2)

#dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE) #13 clusters
#dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.3, verbose = FALSE) #10 clusters
dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.2, verbose = FALSE) #7 clusters
DimPlot(dcSub, reduction = "tsne", split = "HTO_maxID")
DimPlot(dcSub, split.by = "HTO_maxID") #UMAP better
```

```{r}
clusMarkers <- FindAllMarkers(dcSub, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```

Clusters: 
=========
use ARCHS4 Tissues and Mouse Gene Atlas on ENRichr, look at individual genes

|#  |Prof|    Cell type           |Genes               |Datbase|Confidence Fold change|
|---|--|--------------------------|--------------------|-------|-----------|
|0  |++|HSPCs                     |Hist1h1b/Top2a(DNA) |Archs4 | poor  |
|1  |- |DC1                       |high MHCII          |Archs4 |
|2  |+ |?BM/CD34+/TBlast          |Hells/Ctr9/Myl10    |Archs4 | poor  |
|3  |- |pDC                       |Siglech Ccr9 Ctsl   |Archs4 |
|4  |+ |Neutrophil/GMP/Baso       |Elane/Mpo/Ctsg/Cd63 |GeneFunc/MAtlas |
|5  |- |Early lymph               |Ly6d                |Archs4 |
|6  |+ |CD8 DCs           |Ctr9/Myl10          |Archs4 | poor  |

```{r}
#Save clusMarkers into csv file
write.csv(clusMarkers, "Sub_Markers_all_7_clusters.csv")
ttable <- clusMarkers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_logFC)
write.csv(ttable, "Sub_Top10_markers_all_7_clusters.csv")
ttable <- clusMarkers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 4, wt = avg_logFC)
write.csv(ttable, "Sub_Top4_markers_all_7_clusters.csv")
```

## Regress cell cycle using alternative workflow
```{r}
dcSub$CC.Difference <- dcSub$S.Score - dcSub$G2M.Score
dcCC <- ScaleData(dcSub, vars.to.regress = "CC.Difference", features = rownames(dcSub))
```
